data.one_liner: Per-character vertical rolling text and number animation widget.
data.what_it_does: Provides animated widgets like RollingText and RollingNumber that transition characters and numbers vertically using spring physics. It supports stagger effects, chromatic styling, and built-in loader loops.
use_when: You need slot-machine or odometer style number transitions for counters or scores.
You want smooth per-character spring animations for text changes.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based full-screen game animations or rigid-body simulations.
You are animating huge blocks of body text where per-character rolling would hurt readability.
strengths: Built-in spring physics and zero dependencies.
Handles numeric formatting, separators, prefixes, and suffixes automatically.
Includes async waiting and progress loop presets.
weaknesses: Limited to vertical character rolling animations.
Not intended for layout or structural transitions between distinct screens.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a comprehensive general-purpose animation library for fade, slide, scale, and custom effects across any widget rather than just text rolling.

data.minimal_example:
RollingNumber(
  value: _score,
  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 48, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
)
